change: Sprinkle chaos event: rename the AdminPanel row frame SpinkleGrowth -> SprinkleGrowth (authored typo), set MagicWand.PrimaryPart = Handle so the client weld can find the grip, and author IdleAnimationId / WalkAnimationId attributes on the yactiNPC template (its bundled Animate LocalScript cannot run on a client-rendered NPC).
rollback: Rename ReplicatedStorage.UI.Menu.AdminPanel.Panel.SprinkleGrowth back to SpinkleGrowth, set ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Misc.MagicWand.PrimaryPart = nil, and delete both attributes from ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Misc.yactiNPC.

ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Misc.yactiNPC.Scale: ScaleTo(4) — was authored ScaleTo(6). Player avatars measure 5.783 studs, so this is 4x player scale. The MagicWand clone is scaled by rigScale/6 at runtime (SprinkleEvent.AssetsAuthoredAtRigScale) so it stays in proportion, and the walk animation rate is divided by rig scale, so both follow any future rescale with no code change.

notes: IdleAnimationId is deliberately BLANK. The stock R15 idle (507766666) retargets onto this ~4x-scale rig as a splay-legged crouch: measured root-to-feet is 20.1 in the rig's neutral pose but 26.2-28.0 through that idle cycle, with the feet 9 studs apart. With the attribute blank, SprinkleEventController calibrates and holds the neutral standing pose instead; the wand arm is driven by code, not by a track, so the performance is unaffected. Set a suitable idle id here and it will be picked up with no code change.

The walk id is Roblox's stock R15 walk. It also retargets imperfectly (root-to-feet swings 14.2-21.2 across the cycle, so he floats a little mid-stride) but reads acceptably; the controller calibrates whatever is set here.
SprinkleSparklesParticle deliberately keeps Enabled = true in the template. The client clone disables it and uses :Emit(), matching how Assets.VFX.Confetti is handled.
